meta.title: Purchasing and suppliers · Clafina
meta.description: Buy from requisition to payment. Compare quotes, receive in part or whole, match every bill to what arrived and keep suppliers' papers in date.

hero.title: Buy at the right price, and pay only for what arrived.
hero.lede: Requisitions, requests for quote, purchase orders, goods received and supplier bills, each its own document. Stock and the books follow every step.

jobs.title: Order at the right price
jobs.body: Ask several suppliers for quotes, compare them line by line and award the order. If you choose one that is not the lowest, your reason is kept.

jobs.title: Never pay for what never came
jobs.body: Every supplier bill is matched to its order and to what you received. A bill that does not match waits until it does.

jobs.title: Suppliers you can trust
jobs.body: Keep each supplier's papers with their expiry dates. When one runs out, buying from them stops until it is renewed.

tour.title: Compare quotes side by side
tour.body: Quotes come in through the supplier portal or are entered by hand. Each line shows every supplier's price, with the lowest marked, next to delivery times and terms.
points: Award to an order in one step
Choosing a higher quote asks for a reason
Price lists and contracts feed the order price

tour.title: Match every bill
tour.body: A bill is read like a sentence: ordered, then received, then billed. A line is fine when no more is billed than was received.
points: Price differences go to purchase price variance
Bills above a value go to an approver

tour.title: Receive at the door
tour.body: Whoever is at the dock counts each line on a phone against the order, in part or in whole.

faq.q: What stops us paying for goods that never arrived?
faq.a: The three-way match. Each bill is checked against its order and what you received, and a line billed ahead of the goods cannot be posted.

faq.q: Can suppliers answer a request for quote without an account?
faq.a: Yes. They sign in to the supplier portal with a code, with no password to set up. You can also enter a quote they send you.

faq.q: Who can change a supplier's bank account?
faq.a: No one alone. A change to a supplier's bank account needs three people before it is used.
